studies.title: Locked frame / dolly
studies.question: When should the image move toward the reader?
studies.mapping: u → subject turn in both views + B camera distance
studies.mechanism: A fixes position and lens. B moves closer with the same lens; identical subject motion makes the observation comparable.
studies.use: Keep a fixed shot for comparison; use a restrained move when revealing a spatial relationship.
studies.limit: A dollied camera changes perspective and apparent scale together.

studies.title: Tripod / handheld
studies.question: How much embodied motion helps this scene?
studies.mapping: u → canonical 6 s trace → position + aim + roll
studies.mechanism: Several bounded, deterministic sine bands drive small camera translation and roll. The same u always returns the same pose.
studies.use: A brief process moment may tolerate physical presence; measurement and reading benefit from a stable camera.
studies.limit: A designed trace, not motion capture. Reduced-motion mode presents still checkpoints.

studies.title: Rail / curved trajectory
studies.question: What path reveals the assembly most clearly?
studies.mapping: u → equal-distance path sample → camera position + aim
studies.mechanism: Compare a line with a centripetal Catmull–Rom curve sampled by approximate arc length, both aimed at the subject.
studies.use: Use the curve when parallax explains depth; keep straight moves for directional clarity.
studies.limit: Arc length is numerically approximated, not an exact physical rail measurement.

studies.title: Velocity / acceleration
studies.question: Should a move arrive gently or keep a steady reading pace?
studies.mapping: u → path time law → distance, speed and acceleration
studies.mechanism: Both cameras follow one rail. B uses 10u³ − 15u⁴ + 6u⁵; its velocity and acceleration reach zero at the endpoints.
studies.use: Gentle arrival for a detail reveal; constant speed for comparative inspection.
studies.limit: Graphs assume a canonical six-second traversal. Real pointer/wheel velocity is not an extra input.

studies.title: Pan / truck
studies.question: Which movement makes depth legible?
studies.mapping: u → camera aim or lateral camera position
studies.mechanism: A rotates its view at a fixed origin. B translates sideways with a fixed view direction. Foreground posts expose the parallax difference.
studies.use: Truck to explain spatial layers; pan to redirect attention from a stable observer.
studies.limit: The same screen displacement does not imply the same spatial motion.

studies.title: Optical zoom / dolly
studies.question: Is the viewer magnifying or physically approaching?
studies.mapping: u → focal length in A; distance in B
studies.mechanism: A changes PerspectiveCamera field of view at a fixed position. B keeps the lens fixed and moves along its viewing axis.
studies.use: Zoom isolates a detail; dolly exposes relationships between foreground and background.
studies.limit: A focal-length equivalent assumes a 24 mm sensor height; no claim about a particular physical lens.

studies.title: Dolly / compensated zoom
studies.question: Can the surroundings change while the subject holds its size?
studies.mapping: u → distance; B FOV = 2 atan(K / distance)
studies.mechanism: The subject plane at the origin holds approximately constant scale in B. Background frames change relative to it.
studies.use: A deliberate reveal of depth compression; use sparingly in a factual portfolio.
studies.limit: Compensation holds one reference plane, not an entire volumetric subject.

studies.title: Deep focus / focus pull
studies.question: Can focus transfer attention between layers?
studies.mapping: u → focus distance → depth-dependent blur radius
studies.mechanism: B samples the rendered depth texture and applies a bounded screen-space circle-of-confusion approximation. A stays sharp.
studies.use: A short transition between foreground and assembly while labels remain sharp in HTML.
studies.limit: Single-layer depth gather can bleed at silhouettes. It is not a physical lens or bokeh simulation.

studies.title: Clean / black diffusion
studies.question: What does a glow around bright sources contribute?
studies.mechanism: A linear HDR highlight pass is downsampled and blurred in two directions, then gently added back before tone mapping. Dark detail remains present.
studies.use: Restrained atmosphere around practical emitters; keep technical inspection clean.
studies.limit: A digital approximation informed by Tiffen, not a replica of Black Pro-Mist grades or measured optical scatter.

studies.title: Open view / occlusion reveal
studies.question: Can partial concealment make structure easier to discover?
studies.mapping: u → lateral path past an opaque foreground edge
studies.mechanism: The foreground remains fixed. B crosses its edge and reveals the assembly through depth, not a screen wipe.
studies.use: A concise opening reveal that ends in a stable, unobstructed composition.
studies.limit: Do not conceal essential reading or controls. Long concealed intervals add friction.

studies.title: Continuous move / shot sequence
studies.question: Does a cut communicate the hierarchy faster than travel?
studies.mapping: u → continuous distance or three deliberate shot scales
studies.mechanism: B cuts at one-third and two-thirds, preserving the subject side and center. A traverses the same endpoint scales continuously.
studies.use: Three readable beats for orientation, structure and a detail.
studies.limit: A comparison of shot scale and continuity, not a universal editing rule. No real project narrative is implied.

studies.title: Eye level / crane
studies.question: Does elevation reveal a useful relationship?
studies.mapping: u → orbit azimuth + optional camera elevation
studies.mechanism: Both move around the same target. B rises while A holds a constant height; the floor grid makes elevation readable.
studies.use: Rise only when a top relationship is worth showing.
studies.limit: Moving horizon and parallax may compete with nearby reading; prefer a static arrival.

studies.title: Analytic route / authored score
studies.question: When is an authored sequence more useful than a formula?
studies.mapping: u → analytic pose in A; real exported Theatre sequence seek in B
studies.mechanism: B evaluates the existing genuine Studio export with its authored easing and assembly track. Each camera has one writer.
studies.use: A bridge to future shot authoring and the UIUX method reader.
studies.limit: The existing score is reused with provenance. No new Studio export or camera-directing approval is claimed.
